description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to strengthen the management of public finances and to establish a more efficient, effective and transparent public procurement system through: (i) upgrading the public financial management system; (ii) upgrading the e-procurement platform; (iii) enhancing the internal control systems over personnel expenditures; and (iv) building capacity of the Central Administration.

The objectives of the Improving Public Sector Performance Project for Honduras are to strengthen the management of public finances and to establish a more efficient, effective and transparent public procurement system through: (i) upgrading the public financial management system; (ii) upgrading the e-procurement platform; (iii) enhancing the internal control systems over personnel expenditures; and (iv) building capacity of the central administration. There are five components to the project. The first component is strengthening and consolidating financial management systems. The objective of this component is to upgrade the technological platform of the financial management system (SIAFI) and to strengthen its conceptual and functional framework in order to provide a more efficient processing and effective access to financial management information. The second component is to strengthening the public procurement system. The objective of this component is to support the government's initiative to create a regulatory body with specific goals and objectives, thus strengthening overall governance in the public procurement system and to improve transparency and compliance. The third component is improving public sector human resource management. This component has the objective to improve human resource management (HRM) in the public sector through: (i) enhancing controls over personnel expenditures, and (ii) improving the attraction and retention of qualified personnel to gradually increase professionalization of the public service in selected institutions. The fourth component is strengthening government monitoring and evaluation capacity. The objective of this component is to support the implementation and institutionalization of a results-based monitoring and evaluation system for two selected sector cabinets. The fifth component is project coordination.

title.narrative: Additional functionalities of SIAFI system implemented

baseline.value: Some functionalities have not been implemented and others have been implemented partially (travel, HR, administration of goods, etc.)

target.value: All additional functionalities are in place and operating

actual.value: Currently, only the budget formulation module was completed and the Ministry of Finance Modernization Unit (UDEM by its Spanish acronym) is in the processes of preparing the budget modification module. The remaining core financial functionalities (treasury and accounting) have not been yet completely documented and developed. According to UDEMs latest implementation schedule, documentation will be completed by June 2016 and software development will begin in July. The complete set of planned functionalities is expected to begin production on January 2017.

target.value: All additional functionalities are in place and operating

actual.value: The additional functionalities of SIAFI GEs have not been developed. The budget sub-system has become completely operational sinceJune 2015, and has been used in the formulation of the 2016 budget. However, work on the remaining functionalities is scheduled tobegin on 2016, given the project closing date, and the limited time to complete the hiring of the software developing firm beforethe project closing date. However, UDEM has competed the terms of reference and bidding documents for the hiring of the softwaredeveloping firm, and has initiated a the process for the allocation of local funding over FY16 for this purpose. Note that theimplementation of all stages extends beyond the Project closing date and is scheduled to be completed by early 2017 as per thestrategy developed by UDEM. On this regard, the Government has agreed to commit the necessary resources to execute the contract toensure SIAFI GES beyond the closing date.
